# Taprobane German

> Self-study German books for English speakers by Taprobane Holdings: Deutsch: German from Zero (A1–B2) and German for Nurses & Caregivers (B1 Pflege, B2 Pflege, Exam Trainer).

## Deutsch: German from Zero

> Four-book self-study German course for English speakers, CEFR A1 to B2, published by Taprobane Holdings. Paperback and Kindle on Amazon.

- [Deutsch A1 (Beginner)](https://kavindukahanda.github.io/taprobane-german/a1.html): Start German from zero: greetings, numbers, family, time, daily routine, shopping, food, the city and the doctor — explained in plain English. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HMPNDN8H (paperback), https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HMPWHZR4 (Kindle)
- [Deutsch A2 (Elementary)](https://kavindukahanda.github.io/taprobane-german/a2.html): Talk about what you did, where you live, your health, work and plans — and get ready for an A2 exam. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HMS3HQVG (paperback), https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HMS37QX6 (Kindle)
- [Deutsch B1 (Intermediate)](https://kavindukahanda.github.io/taprobane-german/b1.html): Move beyond everyday German: speak, argue and write with confidence at B1. 276 pages. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HMVK97G6 (paperback), https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HMVZ28R4 (Kindle)
- [Deutsch B2 (Upper intermediate)](https://kavindukahanda.github.io/taprobane-german/b2.html): Reach B2: argue, report and write at university and workplace level. 350 pages, over 600 new words with example sentences. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HMYH31LN (paperback), https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HKZPM3NJ (Kindle)

## German for Nurses & Caregivers (Deutsch Pflege)
- [Deutsch B1 Pflege](https://kavindukahanda.github.io/taprobane-german/pflege.html#b1): Ward communication & patient care, 241 pages, exam practice (telc, Goethe, FSP). Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HPL6C95P (paperback), https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HPMHCHT3 (Kindle)
- [Deutsch B2 Pflege](https://kavindukahanda.github.io/taprobane-german/pflege.html#b2): Documentation & difficult conversations, 232 pages, exam practice. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HPZSB2GR (paperback), https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HPMBTJB7 (Kindle)
- [Deutsch Exam Trainer](https://kavindukahanda.github.io/taprobane-german/pflege.html#b3): Band 3, practice tests for nursing German exams (coming soon).

## Free tools
- [German level test](https://kavindukahanda.github.io/taprobane-german/level-test.html): 12-question A1–B2 placement test with book recommendation.
- [Free phrase cards](https://kavindukahanda.github.io/taprobane-german/bonus.html): printable German–English ward phrases for nurses and A1 survival phrases.

## FAQ
- Which book should I start with? If you know no German, start with A1. If you can already introduce yourself and handle simple everyday situations, try A2. Each book ends with a final review and mock exam, so you can check whether you are ready for the next level.
- Can I learn German alone, without a teacher? Yes. Every book is a complete self-study course: grammar is explained in English, every exercise has an answer in the answer key, and AI prompts let you practise speaking and listening with free chat tools.
- Are the books written for English speakers? Yes. All explanations, instructions and grammar notes are in English; the German is introduced step by step.
- Do the books prepare me for Goethe, telc or ÖSD exams? Each book follows the CEFR level and includes an original mock exam in the style of a standard exam at that level, plus exam-skill training. The books are independent and not affiliated with any exam provider.
- What is the difference between A1, A2, B1 and B2? These are the levels of the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR). A1 and A2 cover basic everyday German, B1 lets you handle most everyday and work situations, and B2 is the level often required for university study and skilled work in Germany.
- Is there a Kindle version? Yes. Every level is available as a paperback and as a Kindle eBook, and the Kindle editions are in Kindle Unlimited.
